chapter: Mingus and the call from Hampton
title: Deciding to leave his marriage and Indianapolis
summary: Facing marital problems, Monk decided he had to go, and left on the Sunday after getting the message.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: How long did it take you to make up your mind?
Oh, it was a long time because I was having the

problems with my marriage, but it was still quite a decision because I was hoping it would mend itself. But I knew if I went on the road, there was no hope for it then. It was a hard decision for me to make, but I knew in my heart, inside, I had to hopefully convince her. Because I had to go, because if I didn't, I would have held that against her. I would be going because she didn't want me to go. Then it would turn into hate, and I couldn't gamble that because if I had stayed because she wanted me to stay, then I would say every time I begin to hold that against her, because everything...The first thing that was wrong, I'd have blamed her.

Anyhow, I couldn't undo that; I couldn't do anything about that. And I remember that Sunday I left. I got the message on a Friday, I called him Saturday and I left that Sunday, Sunday morning. And, seem like the...it was like the whole, the world behind me begin to close up like a light. You know how those spotlights, they close it up and it goes out, with that behind me. Because I knew ahead of me was a whole new experience I could never even imagine. I couldn't think, and I couldn't gather my thoughts about how I would adjust to it because it was just, it was just too overwhelming to...
